images.dither_hint: Floyd-Steinberg suits most photos. Atkinson draws areas more crisply (up to 512×2000 px), Bayer produces an even dot pattern.

images.preview_hint: {width}×{height} px at the real print width (512 px), one image pixel is one printed dot.
images.preview_network_error: Could not load the preview. Is the server reachable?
images.preview_timeout: The preview took too long and was cancelled.
images.preview_caption_hint: The message prints in the printer's font, so its line breaks here are approximate.

images.error.atkinson_timeout: Atkinson took longer than {seconds} s and was cancelled. Please choose Floyd-Steinberg or Bayer.
images.error.unreadable: The image could not be read (PNG or JPG only).

settings.index.backup.name: Backup
settings.index.backup.desc: Back up and restore settings and logos
backup.token_hint: The API_TOKEN from config.py. Backup and restore don't work without it.
backup.download.heading: Download backup
backup.download.sensitive: The file contains no passwords, tokens or keys, but personal data: server host and user names, places with coordinates, addresses and GitHub repos. Store it accordingly.
backup.download.included: Included: settings (print rules, weather, language, design, modules, recipe address, servers, GitHub repos, logo switches) and all logo files.
backup.download.excluded: Not included: config.py, all passwords and tokens, the key for stored passwords, the servers' commands, print history, pending jobs and list drafts.
backup.download.too_large: Note: this backup is larger than {max_mb} MB and could not be restored. Use smaller logo files.
backup.restore.heading: Restore backup
backup.restore.hint: The file is only checked first. Nothing changes until you confirm. The current state is saved beforehand (the last 5 are kept). Passwords and tokens on this device stay unchanged.
backup.summary.heading: Backup contents
backup.summary.logos_hint: Only the logo slots in the backup are replaced, all others stay as they are.
backup.summary.ignored_hint: These fields don't belong in a backup and are not applied.
backup.summary.invalid: The backup contains invalid values and can't be restored:
backup.confirm.hint: Restoring replaces the areas listed above.
backup.confirm.checkbox: I have read the summary and want to restore this backup.
backup.result.nothing_to_reenter: Nothing is missing for the restored settings.
backup.result.config_hint: These values only live in config.py and are never part of a backup. On a new device, set them there.
backup.result.ssh_key_hint: Servers using key login need this device's SSH key in their authorized_keys.
backup.result.no_restart: No restart needed, the changes apply immediately.
backup.result.snapshot: The previous state was saved as {name}.
backup.reenter.mealie_token: Recipes: Mealie token (the provider stays off until then).
backup.conflict.mealie_url: Recipes: this device's address stays, because a token for exactly that address is stored here.
backup.conflict.host_password: Server “{name}”: stays as on this device, because a password for it is stored here.
backup.conflict.host_kept: Server “{name}”: not in the backup, but kept because a password for it is stored here.
backup.error.restore_locked: Restoring is locked as long as no API_TOKEN is set in config.py.
backup.error.admin_required: Backup and restore require an admin account.
backup.error.too_large: The backup is too large (max. {max_mb} MB).
backup.error.not_zip: The file is not a valid ZIP file.
backup.error.not_backup: The file is not a ReceiptPi backup or is damaged.
backup.error.unsafe_path: Path not allowed in the backup: “{name}”.
backup.error.symlink: The backup contains a symbolic link: “{name}”.
backup.error.duplicate_file: The backup contains a file twice.
backup.error.newer_format: The backup uses a newer format ({version}) and can't be restored with this version.
backup.error.newer_app: The backup comes from ReceiptPi {version}, this device runs {current}. Please update first.
backup.error.manifest_mismatch: The contents don't match the backup's file list (file changed or damaged).
backup.error.settings_invalid: The settings in the backup are invalid.
backup.error.not_image: “{name}” is not a valid PNG image.
backup.error.staging_expired: The checked backup is gone or expired. Please upload it again.
backup.error.queue_busy: A print job is running. Please wait until it's done and try again.
backup.error.apply_failed: The restore failed, the previous state is unchanged.
backup.validation.locations_count: There must be at least one weather location (at most 100).
backup.validation.default_location: The default location is not in the list of weather locations.
backup.validation.ssh_target: A server has an invalid host or user name.
backup.validation.github_name: A GitHub repo has an invalid name.

settings.language.heading: Language
settings.language.hint_device: Device default: applies on the login page, to accounts without their own choice and to receipts without their own receipt language. Every account can pick its own language under "My settings".
settings.logos.global_hint: Master switch - when off, no logo is printed anywhere, regardless of the settings below.
settings.print_rules.pending_retention_h: 0 = never auto-delete, stays until you manually print or discard it.
settings.print_rules.heading: Rate limit & duplicate suppression
settings.print_rules.invalid_numbers: Rate limit, duplicate window and retention must be numbers
settings.print_rules.text_size_hint: Affects the heading and body text on the receipt, plus the font size and tile layout of the web UI. The date/time at the end and separator lines on the receipt always stay at normal size.
settings.quiet_hours.empty: No quiet-hours rules defined - printing is allowed at any time.
settings.quiet_hours.heading: Quiet hours
settings.quiet_hours.label: Label (optional)
settings.storm_warning.dwd_hint: State and county exactly as used by DWD - see the official list at dwd.de/DE/leistungen/opendata/help/warnungen/cap_warncellids_csv.html
settings.storm_warning.heading: Storm warning
settings.storm_warning.ignore_quiet_hour: Only affects the storm warning, not other print types. Rate limit and duplicate suppression still apply.
settings.storm_warning.meteoalarm_hint: Country as the URL slug used by feeds.meteoalarm.org (e.g. "germany", "united-kingdom"), region exactly as listed on meteoalarm.org for that country.
settings.system_report.command_hint: Runs verbatim over SSH on the host - every line of output ends up in the report as-is.
settings.system_report.hint: Key-auth hosts need no password here. For password hosts, the password is stored encrypted (see the info icon by the password field) - but note: everything here is viewable/editable on the local network without any further login.
settings.system_report.password_hint: Leave empty = SSH key auth (recommended). Filled in = password login instead of a key.
settings.system_report.password_info: The password is stored encrypted, never in plain text, and only briefly decrypted to connect. Recommendation: a dedicated, restricted user instead of root - so even a compromised password only does limited damage.
settings.system_report.password_placehol: Leave empty for SSH key auth
settings.system_report.role_info: "Custom command" runs the entered SSH command verbatim on the target host - with the rights of the user entered there. A restricted user instead of root is recommended.
settings.system_report.ssh_key_hint: Requires passwordless SSH access (public key) from ReceiptPi to these hosts - or password login instead (see field below).
settings.validation.days_invalid: days must be distinct numbers between 0 (Monday) and 6 (Sunday)
settings.validation.days_missing: At least one weekday must be selected
settings.validation.duplicate_window: "Duplicate suppression (seconds)" must be a whole number of at least 0
settings.validation.pending_retention: "Auto-delete pending jobs after (days)" must be a whole number of at least 0
settings.validation.enabled_bool: enabled must be true or false
settings.validation.github_repo_missing: Owner and repository must not be empty
settings.validation.max_jobs: "Max. print jobs per hour" must be a whole number of at least 1
settings.validation.ssh_host_invalid: Invalid host: hostname, IPv4 or IPv6 address only (letters, digits, . - _ : % [ ], max. 253 characters, starting with a letter, digit or [)
settings.validation.ssh_user_invalid: Invalid username: letters, digits, . _ - only (max. 64 characters, must not start with - or .)
settings.validation.ssh_user_missing: Username missing for {role} (required when a host is set)
settings.validation.system_report_comman: SSH command must not be empty for type "Custom command"
settings.validation.system_report_host_m: Host and user must not be empty
settings.weather_locations.heading: Weather locations
settings.weather_locations.last_cannot_d: The last remaining location can't be deleted
settings.weather_locations.name: Name
settings.weather_provider.heading: Weather report provider
settings.weather_provider.report_hint: Only affects the regular weather report, not the storm warning (separate setting below).

settings.index.mqtt.name: MQTT
settings.index.mqtt.desc: Broker, print commands, printer status and Home Assistant
settings.mqtt.hint: ReceiptPi connects to your MQTT broker, accepts print commands and reports the printer status. Commands go through the same print rules as the HTTP API (quiet hours, rate limit, duplicate suppression).
settings.mqtt.status.library_missing: The paho-mqtt library is not installed
settings.mqtt.warning_no_auth: No user name set: anyone allowed to publish on the broker can print. Set up users and access rules on the broker.
settings.mqtt.warning_no_tls: Without TLS, credentials and print content cross the network unencrypted.
settings.mqtt.tls_hint: The broker's certificate and host name are verified (system CAs or your own CA below). Usual port: 8883.
settings.mqtt.password_placeholder_saved: leave empty to keep the saved password
settings.mqtt.password_hint: Stored encrypted and never shown, never returned by the API and never included in a backup. Has to be entered again after changing broker or port, or switching TLS off.
settings.mqtt.discovery_hint: Creates a device in Home Assistant with printer status, problem, pending jobs, last job and a weather report button. Removed again when switched off.
settings.mqtt.host_invalid: Invalid host name or IP address.
settings.mqtt.prefix_invalid: Invalid prefix: letters, digits, _ and - only, levels separated by /, at most 64 characters, not "homeassistant".
settings.mqtt.username_invalid: Invalid user name (at most 128 characters, no control characters).
settings.mqtt.password_invalid: Invalid password (at most 256 characters, no control characters).
settings.mqtt.password_needs_username: A password needs a user name.
settings.mqtt.password_required_new_targ: Broker, port or TLS changed – please enter the password again.
settings.mqtt.password_delete_hint: Removes the saved password from this device.
settings.mqtt.ca_hint: Only needed if the broker's certificate comes from your own CA. Not included in a backup.
settings.mqtt.ca_too_large: The file is too large (at most 64 KB).
settings.mqtt.ca_invalid: The file is not a valid PEM certificate.
backup.conflict.mqtt_host: MQTT: this device has a password saved for its current broker, so broker, port and TLS were left unchanged.
backup.reenter.mqtt_password: MQTT: enter the password (and user name, if needed) again on the MQTT page.
